wc_rep_desc: Describe what you were doing and what went wrong. Do not type participant names or other personal details.
wc_rep_ph: For example: I pasted my data, pressed Parse, and the page showed an error.
wc_rep_added_h: What the app adds to the report.
wc_rep_added: This is everything. Nothing from your documents, sources, data or keys is included.
wc_rep_usage_tick: Also include how often I opened each tool (counts only, no text)
wc_rep_local: Which tools you used and where errors occurred. Nobody sees this unless you tick the box above.
wc_rep_closing: The email opens in your own email app. You read it and press send yourself.
wc_rep_copy_fail: Could not copy. Select the text by hand.
wc_rep_long: The report is long, so it was copied too. Paste it into the email if it looks cut off.
